name: Togetsu Kan
source:
The protagonist of the Togetsu Arc. 
A nomadic sorcerer hired by the Arai group. He earns his living by using curses for assassination. Sporting a laid-back vibe that screams disinterest, this middle-aged man favors a no-nonsense, detached approach. 
Though Kan appears to have some history with the Futatsuguri family, he doesn't seem keen on discussing the details.

"Geez... So, everyone but you's an enemy, huh? Classic."
